title: Senior Backend Engineer Mastery
summary: This roadmap elevates your backend engineering skills by focusing on advanced system design, robust API patterns, and production-grade reliability. It prepares you for senior-level interviews and client-facing roles through polished portfolio projects and leadership-focused technical depth.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Solidify your core language and database expertise to ensure a rock-solid base for advanced architectural decisions.

milestones.title: Language Proficiency
milestones.outcome: You can write idiomatic, high-performance code in your chosen backend language and explain memory management trade-offs.

tasks.title: Refactor legacy code for performance
tasks.description: Take a slow function from a previous project and optimize it using profiling tools like cProfile or pprof. Document the before-and-after metrics.

tasks.title: Implement concurrent worker pool
tasks.description: Build a simple task runner in Python or Go that processes items concurrently using threads or goroutines. Handle error propagation correctly.

tasks.title: Study official style guides
tasks.description: Read the PEP 8 or Go Code Review Comments and apply one specific rule to a small codebase snippet. Explain why the rule matters for maintainability.

tasks.title: Debug a memory leak scenario
tasks.description: Introduce a deliberate memory leak in a test script and use a debugger or profiler to identify the source. Write a brief post-mortem on the detection process.

milestones.title: Data Modeling Depth
milestones.outcome: You can design normalized schemas that handle complex relationships and write optimized queries for large datasets.

tasks.title: Design a many-to-many schema
tasks.description: Create a database schema for a blog system with posts, tags, and authors. Include junction tables and appropriate foreign key constraints.

tasks.title: Optimize a slow query
tasks.description: Take a complex JOIN query with poor performance and add indexes to improve execution time. Use EXPLAIN ANALYZE to verify the improvement.

tasks.title: Implement database migrations
tasks.description: Write a migration script that adds a new column to an existing table without downtime. Test it on a local PostgreSQL instance.

tasks.title: Analyze index fragmentation
tasks.description: Research how B-tree indexes work and write a short summary on when to use partial indexes versus full indexes. Apply this to a sample dataset.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Master the patterns and security practices that define professional backend services, focusing on API design and state management.

milestones.title: API Architecture
milestones.outcome: You can design RESTful endpoints with proper versioning, error handling, and pagination that scale to high traffic.

tasks.title: Implement cursor-based pagination
tasks.description: Build an API endpoint that returns paginated results using cursor-based logic instead of offset. Ensure the cursor is opaque and secure.

tasks.title: Standardize error responses
tasks.description: Create a middleware that catches exceptions and formats them into a consistent JSON error structure with appropriate HTTP status codes.

tasks.title: Design API versioning strategy
tasks.description: Write a technical design document outlining how to version your API using URI paths or headers. Include migration strategies for clients.

tasks.title: Add request validation layer
tasks.description: Implement a validation layer that checks incoming JSON payloads against a schema before processing. Return detailed validation errors.

milestones.title: Security Implementation
milestones.outcome: You can implement secure authentication flows and protect endpoints against common web vulnerabilities.

tasks.title: Implement JWT refresh flow
tasks.description: Build an authentication system that issues short-lived access tokens and long-lived refresh tokens. Handle token rotation securely.

tasks.title: Add rate limiting middleware
tasks.description: Implement a rate limiter that tracks requests per user IP or token. Return 429 status codes when limits are exceeded.

tasks.title: Audit dependency security
tasks.description: Run a security scanner on your project dependencies and address any high-severity vulnerabilities. Document the remediation steps.

tasks.title: Implement CSRF protection
tasks.description: Add CSRF tokens to state-changing endpoints in a web application context. Test that requests without valid tokens are rejected.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Build production-quality projects that demonstrate your ability to handle concurrency, data integrity, and complex business logic.

milestones.title: Secure API Project
milestones.outcome: You have a deployed REST API with full authentication, comprehensive tests, and clear documentation that demonstrates senior-level engineering.

tasks.title: Build user management API
tasks.description: Create endpoints for user registration, login, and profile updates. Ensure all sensitive data is hashed and encrypted at rest.

tasks.title: Write integration test suite
tasks.description: Write end-to-end tests that cover the main user flows, including error cases. Use a test database to ensure isolation.

tasks.title: Document API with OpenAPI
tasks.description: Generate an OpenAPI specification for your API and host it using a free service like Swagger UI. Ensure all endpoints are documented.

tasks.title: Deploy to cloud platform
tasks.description: Deploy your API to a free tier cloud provider like Heroku or Render. Configure environment variables and health checks.

milestones.title: Background Job System
milestones.outcome: You have a reliable background job processor that handles asynchronous tasks with retries and monitoring.

tasks.title: Implement job queue worker
tasks.description: Build a worker that consumes jobs from a queue like Redis or RabbitMQ. Handle job failures with exponential backoff.

tasks.title: Add job monitoring dashboard
tasks.description: Create a simple endpoint that returns the status of recent jobs, including success/failure counts and average processing time.

tasks.title: Test job idempotency
tasks.description: Write tests that verify jobs can be retried safely without side effects. Simulate duplicate job submissions.

tasks.title: Optimize job batching
tasks.description: Modify the worker to process jobs in batches to reduce database overhead. Measure the performance improvement.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish your portfolio with advanced scalability patterns and prepare for senior-level interviews by mastering system design and testing strategies.

milestones.title: Scalability Patterns
milestones.outcome: You can implement caching and queuing strategies to handle high load and explain the trade-offs of each approach.

tasks.title: Implement cache-aside pattern
tasks.description: Add a Redis cache layer to your API for frequently accessed data. Implement invalidation logic when data changes.

tasks.title: Design event-driven architecture
tasks.description: Refactor a part of your application to use events for communication between services. Use a message broker like Kafka or RabbitMQ.

tasks.title: Analyze cache stampede risk
tasks.description: Write a technical note on how to prevent cache stampedes using techniques like request coalescing or probabilistic early expiration.

tasks.title: Implement dead letter queue
tasks.description: Add a dead letter queue to your job processor to capture failed jobs that exceed retry limits. Build a tool to inspect these jobs.

milestones.title: Interview Readiness
milestones.outcome: You can demonstrate robust testing practices and articulate your technical decisions clearly in a senior-level interview context.

tasks.title: Implement property-based testing
tasks.description: Use a library like Hypothesis or Go's testing framework to write property-based tests for a complex business logic function.

tasks.title: Create load testing script
tasks.description: Write a load test using a tool like Locust or k6 to simulate 100 concurrent users. Analyze the results for bottlenecks.

tasks.title: Prepare system design answers
tasks.description: Practice explaining the design of a URL shortener or chat system, focusing on scalability, consistency, and failure modes.

tasks.title: Conduct peer code review
tasks.description: Review a colleague's or open-source PR, providing constructive feedback on code quality, security, and maintainability. Document your feedback.
